name: Telegram Bot API
description: Self-hosted local Telegram Bot API server packaged by aiogram. Removes standard cloud Bot API limits (such as 50 MB file uploads and 20 MB downloads, supporting up to 2000 MB), enables local file access, and provides dedicated webhook and polling performance.
short_desc: Self-hosted local Telegram Bot API server by aiogram
author: aiogram / tdlib

form_fields.label: Telegram API ID
form_fields.hint: API ID from your Telegram client account obtained at my.telegram.org (not the bot token).

form_fields.label: Telegram API Hash
form_fields.hint: API Hash from your Telegram client account obtained at my.telegram.org (not the bot token).

form_fields.label: TELEGRAM_LOCAL
form_fields.hint: Allows the Bot API server to handle local requests and access local files. Default: 1 (leave unchanged to keep standard behavior).

form_fields.label: TELEGRAM_HTTP_PORT
form_fields.hint: Internal HTTP port on which telegram-bot-api listens inside the container. Default: 2627 (change the Runtipi Port field to adjust the external host port).

form_fields.label: TELEGRAM_STAT
form_fields.hint: Enables the Bot API server HTTP statistics endpoint. Default: 1 (leave unchanged to keep standard behavior).

form_fields.label: TELEGRAM_VERBOSITY
form_fields.hint: Log verbosity level for the Bot API server (0 = minimal, higher values = more detail). Default: 0.
